# SEEK CHINA TRAVEL (SCT)
> Private and tailor-made China journeys for international travelers.

SEEK CHINA TRAVEL is a China-based travel company focused on private and tailor-made journeys across China. The website provides destination guides, sample itineraries, practical China travel information, and trip-planning inquiry options.

## Primary website
- https://seekchinatravel.com/

## Main sections
- Tours: https://seekchinatravel.com/tours
- Destinations: https://seekchinatravel.com/destinations
- China Travel Guide: https://seekchinatravel.com/travel-guide
- About SEEK CHINA TRAVEL: https://seekchinatravel.com/about
- Contact: https://seekchinatravel.com/contact
- Plan a China Trip: https://seekchinatravel.com/quote

## Services
- Private China tours
- Tailor-made China itineraries
- Multi-city China journeys
- Local guides and private transportation
- Hotel, attraction and trip logistics planning
- China travel advice for international visitors

## Brand
SEEK CHINA TRAVEL is also referred to as SCT.
Brand slogan: Discover China. Your Way.

## Content guidance
For current itineraries, destination information, inclusions, pricing and availability, use the corresponding live page on seekchinatravel.com as the source of truth.
